question: A water tank can be filled in 12 hours using three pipes. Pipe Z is three times as fast as pipe C, and pipe C is twice as fast as pipe B. How long will it take pipe B alone to fill the tank?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

B : C : Z = 1 : 2 : 6

Total efficiency = 1 + 2 + 6 = 9

3 pipes fill in 12 hr ⇒ total work = 9 × 12 = 108

B efficiency = 1 ⇒ time = 108 ÷ 1

**∴ Answer = 108 hours**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total time with 3 pipes = 12 hours

Z is 3 times C ⇒ Z = 3C

C is 2 times B ⇒ C = 2B

**Formula used:**

Efficiency ∝ work done per unit time
